1879189304.desc: A set of scrolls inscribed with lore to imbue weapons with potent virtues by one properly versed in the art.\n\nHowever they must be inscribed in some old language known only to the Dúnedain, for you cannot read them.

1879189560.name: Tome of Sustained Recovery
1879189560.desc: Provides a temporary increase to your recovery of morale and power out of combat.

1879189688.name: Corrupted Phial

A journeyman strong trap does not hold as long, but will not release the target when damaged. The trap remains for 60 seconds after being placed.

Most effective against targets level 25 or lower.

<rgb=#00FFDD>Mounted Combat Enemies: Root replaced with a mount acceleration debuff</rgb>

1879190328.name: Grant Human-dance3 Emote

1879198648.name: Hardy Branch

stats.description: - *  All Threat

You will not be able to move, use skills or auto attack.  Also, any stance you are in will be automatically turned off.

1879223480.name: Exquisite Premium Drum of the Wary Watcher

-2.5% Pet Incoming Damage

1879325496.desc: This history of the Elves is extensive, full of names and dates, and you feel certain you could spend a long time getting lost within its pages.

1879328056.name: Anórien Tactics Signal
1879328056.desc: Increases the effectiveness of your Tactics fellowship skills.

stats.description: +15% Fellowship Manoeuvre Power Healing Multiplier from Tactics
Exploit Opening Also Adds Buff

1879347768.desc: Is there anything of value in here?

1879349048.desc: A pitch-black, shining fragment of Black Adamant.\n\nThis rare shard is sought after by Doomfold crafters.

1879351224.name: Doomfold Chisel
1879351224.desc: Rune-keepers can attune themselves to specially crafted chisels, enhancing their powers.

1879351480.name: Tome of the Sunflower Kite
1879351480.desc: Using this item will teach you to summon a sunflower kite.

1879355960.name: Metal Base
1879355960.desc: This looks like a good location to plant a banner of Gondor.

1879358776.name: Forgotten Page
1879358776.desc: And so, the Lord of the Nazgûl granted the Weeping Warrior the Dwarf-ring, Sindya, to draw the Worm from the Ered Luin. Powerless to resist his greed, the great Worm followed the Weeping Warrior into the East. When at last the Worm tired in his pursuit, he fell broken before the Ephel Dúath.

1879360312.name: Dino's Dropped Pack
1879360312.desc: Dinodas dropped this pack when he ran away.

1879365816.name: Dusty Page
1879365816.desc: To Khazad-dûm we retreated then, but at last the wakened dragons came and found us there. With the aid of Elves and Men, we bested them, though the cost was great, and for a time knew peace.

1879367992.name: Sea-ward Legs
1879367992.desc: This item will reward your character with the Mounted Combat appearance trait, Sea-ward Legs.

1879368248.name: Pile of Curfew Notices
1879368248.desc: A pile of formal notices from the Master of Lake-town to enforce a curfew.

1879368376.name: Restored Rare Vanguard Rune of Binding
1879368376.desc: A Relic-master can deconstruct this item, unsealing the relic locked within.\nSlottable in class items only.

1879369528.name: Forgotten Letter

1879370168.name: Scroll of Ironfold Warding Lore

1879376440.name: Rusted Page
1879376440.desc:
'Still through long years of dauntless toil
Lord Grár the Grave dug stone and soil
The Fast was mended, whole once more
And grander even than before
And so returned our wealth of Iron

Iron hard and iron cold'

1879378360.name: Tome of the Fiery Red Beetle
1879378360.desc: Using this item will teach you to summon a fiery red beetle.

1879385144.name: Malformed Snow Etten
1879385144.desc: Something just doesn't seem quite right with this snowman.

1879386680.name: Vales of Anduin Theorbo of Harmony

1879388216.desc: A Relic-master can deconstruct this item, unsealing the relic locked within.

1879390520.name: Beorn's Table
1879390520.desc: A recreation of one of Beorn's many feasts.

1879393336.name: The Claw - Imbued Third Age Two-handed Axe

1879398712.name: Bow Chant: Gundabad Foe-finder

A malleable essence. These may be acquired by using the Flame of Ancalamír on powerful Moonlit Essences.

These may be used as Ingredient Packs in Moonlit Essence Recipes.

These items do not go into carry-alls or the barter wallet.

1879404344.name: Sealed Darkened Remmorchant Gem of Agility
1879404344.desc: A Relic-master can deconstruct this item, unsealing the relic locked within.

1879406392.name: Minas Ithil Scholar Crafting
1879406392.desc: This item will allow you to finish Minas Ithil Tier Scholar crafting.
